title: Assembly manifest (schemaVersion 1)
description: BOM + executable interface contracts. mm, z-up. A node's interfaces connect its DIRECT children; endpoint strings are "<childId>.<datumName>". The root is the assembly. Distinct from `type` on an interface (the fit kind, e.g. 转动副): the node discriminator is `kind`.

manufacturing.description: Project-level manufacturing policy: the user-approved set of available/acceptable processes. The agent assigns each part a process from `allowed` (delegated); per-part confirmation is not required. One policy decision replaces N part questions.

approvedBy.description: User/human who approved this option set (a name or a document like PROMPT.md).

mixApprovedBy.description: User/human who approved the process mix (the per-part assignment summary); absent = the mix is still a proposal.

delegate.description: Default true: the agent may choose a part's process from `allowed` without asking per part.

transform.description: world = translate ∘ rotate(euler XYZ) ∘ pose; all in the part's local frame.

rotate.description: degrees; R = Rz(z)·Ry(y)·Rx(x), the OpenSCAD/Manifold rotate([x,y,z]) composition (three.js order 'ZYX'; its default 'XYZ' is the reverse order)

pose.description: Rotation about a named datum axis (assembly/meshing pose); the datum follows the part.

id.description: unique within the owning node, e.g. "I1"

a.description: "<direct child id>.<datum name>"; a dot, not ':' or '/'

type.description: fit kind; drives the default operator/layer

severity.description: hard = engine error; intent = human flag

check.description: Explicit operator; overrides the one derived from type. Implemented: distance, diameter-match, coaxial, motion-clearance, spring-preload, spring-behaviour, snap-fit. An unknown operator is not a schema error — it comes back skipped with its name.

params.description: Legacy numeric bag. distance: {distanceMm}; spring-preload: {freeLengthMm, stiffnessNPerMm}; spring-behaviour/snap-fit: use `elastic`. For the run that proves a motion/spring interface, prefer `evidence.runId`; `params.runId` remains accepted.

evidence.description: External evidence for the half this engine cannot decide (motion travel, spring behaviour): the run that proved it. Motion-clearance turns a missing/unresolvable/cross-version cite into a hard violation, never a silent pass.

elastic.description: General elastic-behaviour declaration; takes precedence over the legacy numeric `params` bag. spring-behaviour dispatches on behavior; unimplemented behaviors are skipped by name. Thresholds (forceBudgetN/requiredTravelMm) are USER-DECLARED acceptance criteria: the venue compares against them, it does not invent child/adult or product thresholds.

standardId.description: Optional seed-catalog id; fills only fields not declared explicitly. Unknown ids are a validation error. Currently axial-spring standard parts only.

direction.description: Omitted = report the deflection sign, do not enforce.

freeLengthMm.description: Free (unloaded) length along the a→b line, mm.

solidHeightMm.description: Coils-touching height, mm. Omit if unknown.

outerDiameterMm.description: Only for a slenderness ATTENTION, never a hard fail.

guided.description: Guided compression spring: suppresses the slenderness attention.

forceBudgetN.description: USER-DECLARED max absolute force, N. No value = no acceptance judgement.

stiffnessTolerancePct.description: Display-band half-width on k, percent; 0/absent = no k band.

lobeCount.description: snap-fit: number of elastic lobes (1 = single cantilever).

lobeWidthMm.description: snap-fit: width of one lobe at its root, mm.

lobeThicknessMm.description: snap-fit: wall thickness of the lobe, mm.

radialInterferenceMm.description: snap-fit: radial interference at the bead/undercut, mm.

youngModulusMPa.description: snap-fit: Young's modulus, MPa (beam force; strain does not need it).

leadAngleDeg.description: snap-fit: lead/insertion face angle from the insertion axis, degrees.

frictionCoeff.description: snap-fit: coefficient of friction on the lead face.

retentionAngleDeg.description: snap-fit: same wedge model for the retention face; default = leadAngleDeg.

maxStrainPct.description: snap-fit: USER-DECLARED allowable root strain, percent.

retentionLoadN.description: snap-fit: USER-DECLARED required retention load, N.

source.description: Where k / E came from; reported, not judged.

part.description: accepted alias for a part's display name (ignored by the checker)

version.description: part only: version id in the store

source.description: stock with a version has geometry and is checked like an imported part; stock without a version is BOM-only

group.description: Functional group (功能区) this part belongs to, e.g. "底座组". At most ONE group per part; a small part (screw, nut, pin) may have none. Groups are a PARTITION OF PARTS, not a spatial region: a group's envelope is computed as the union of its members' bounding boxes. Budgets attach to groups (see assembly/budget.json), never to parts.

role.description: Appearance ownership. Default when omitted: source=stock -> purchased, otherwise printed. `reference` = vendor geometry kept for fit checking only: it occludes in the scene but is never judged, because you cannot change it.

color.description: Identity colour for COMMUNICATION only (#rrggbb): used where colour already exists — assembly and playback rendering — so the agent and the human name the same part. Not a material, finish or spec; it does not introduce colour anywhere there was none (reports, tables, contracts stay uncoloured).

brief.description: Kickoff alignment, recorded BEFORE modelling: what was decided with the user and what the agent assumed. `by=assumed` means nobody confirmed it — delivery_audit prints those entries so a human can see who decided what. Not a gate.

buyVsMake.description: Per item: bought or made. Standard parts (gears, bearings, springs, motors, fasteners) default to a QUESTION, not to make.

processes.description: The SET of processes the user allows (multi-select: FDM, sheet metal, CNC, moulding). The agent then picks per part; the per-part choice with its provenance stays in `process`.

verify.description: What "working" means for this deliverable; ENFORCED: a declared motion/strength needs a FRESH run citing the newest version, or delivery is blocked. Omitted entirely + a kinematic interface (转动副/滑动副/弹簧) => motion is required by derivation. Narrowing it (e.g. ["assembly"]) is a user decision and is printed as verify-waived, never as a pass.

assumptions.description: Every reversible default the agent took instead of asking. Listed in the delivery report.

process.description: Manufacturing process for this part (or the default for an assembly's children). source=user is a confirmed decision; source=agent is a recommendation awaiting user confirmation. The delivery plan reports an unconfirmed recommendation as unobserved, never as a settled process.

id.description: Process/profile id, e.g. injection-pp, fdm-pla-0.4, cnc-alu.

source.description: Who decided: the user (explicit), a user-approved manufacturing policy (agent delegated within allowed), or the agent's recommendation (needs confirmation).

rationale.description: Why this process: geometry/quantity/tolerance/available equipment. Advisory, not a verdict.

confirmedBy.description: User/human who confirmed an agent recommendation (a name or a document like PROMPT.md).

confirmedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the confirmation; with confirmedBy it makes an agent recommendation settled.

features.description: CHECK-ONLY feature declarations (v1: hole-pattern). The checker verifies the version mesh against them; the plugin never generates geometry from them, so features do not become a second modelling path.

axis.description: Hole axis in the part's own frame; need not be unit.

centerMm.description: A point on the pattern axis (e.g. flange-face centre), part frame, mm.

toleranceMm.description: Allowed deviation for diameter/radius/axis, mm. Default 0.2.

through.description: Require every matched hole to be through.

interfaces.description: contracts between this node's DIRECT children
